subject: mathematics
instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: A regular quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle of radius 11. What central angle does each side subtend?
Which statement correctly justifies the perpendicular bisector construction?
choices: The arcs look symmetric, so the line must be perpendicular.
Any line through the midpoint is a perpendicular bisector.
Both constructed points are equidistant from the endpoints, and the locus of such points is exactly the perpendicular bisector.
The compass width was more than half the segment, which forces perpendicularity.

learnerTasks.prompt: Which statement is a precise definition of a circle?
choices: a closed curve with no corners
a shape whose area is πr²
a polygon with infinitely many sides
the set of all points in a plane at a fixed distance from a given centre point

learnerTasks.prompt: A construction proceeds as follows. From vertex V draw an arc crossing both rays at P and Q. From P and Q draw equal arcs meeting at R. Draw ray VR. What has been constructed?
choices: an equilateral triangle on PQ
the perpendicular bisector of PQ only
the bisector of the angle at V
a line perpendicular to one ray

learnerTasks.prompt: A regular hexagon is inscribed in a circle of radius 8. What central angle does each side subtend?
Which statement correctly justifies the equilateral triangle construction on a given segment?
choices: The construction works only when the segment is horizontal.
Both circles have radius equal to the segment, so all three sides are that same length.
The circles intersect, which guarantees 60° angles by definition.
The intersection point is the midpoint of the segment.

learnerTasks.prompt: Which statement is a precise definition of a angle?
choices: a corner of a polygon
the figure formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint
the space between two intersecting lines
the amount of turn measured in degrees

learnerTasks.prompt: A construction proceeds as follows. With the compass set to the radius, mark successive arcs around the circle from a starting point, then join consecutive marks. What has been constructed?
choices: an equilateral triangle inscribed in the circle
a square inscribed in the circle
a regular pentagon inscribed in the circle
a regular hexagon inscribed in the circle

learnerTasks.prompt: A regular hexagon is inscribed in a circle of radius 3. What central angle does each side subtend?
Which statement correctly justifies the angle bisector construction?
choices: Equal arcs always produce equal angles regardless of the triangle.
The construction builds two congruent triangles by SSS, so the angles at the vertex are congruent.
The ray drawn appears to split the angle evenly.
The construction relies on the angle being acute.

learnerTasks.prompt: Which statement is a precise definition of a line segment?
choices: the set of two endpoints and all points between them on the line through them
a line with a measurable length
part of a line that goes on forever in one direction
the shortest path between two shapes

learnerTasks.prompt: A construction proceeds as follows. Through point P not on line ℓ, copy the angle that a transversal makes with ℓ, placing the copy at P on the same transversal. What has been constructed?
choices: a line through P perpendicular to ℓ
the perpendicular bisector of the transversal
the reflection of ℓ across P
a line through P parallel to ℓ
